baseline_note: P3.6 proposal-integration baseline. Assumptions are not facts, approvals or statutory decisions; P3.4 geometry semantics are preserved and current field outcomes remain UNKNOWN.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, rail safety limits, heritage controls, fire conditions and engineering constraints have not been fully obtained.
assumptions.impact: No statutory plan, fixed alignment, demolition decision, engineering feasibility claim or approval claim may be made from this package.
assumptions.recheck_trigger: Receipt of current official control plans, project approvals, surveys and discipline-specific review records.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site and key-area polygons are organizer-provided provisional/inferred geometry for scaffold use, not official redlines or cadastral boundaries.
assumptions.impact: Areas and ratios calculated from them are CONCEPTUAL_DERIVED only and cannot support statutory, ownership or investment conclusions.
assumptions.recheck_trigger: Publication of trusted official SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons.

assumptions.statement: Project status records describe the latest official evidence located by 2026-08-12; they are not permanent facts.
assumptions.impact: A planned completion date never upgrades a project to BUILT, and an earlier construction report remains UNDER_CONSTRUCTION until completion/acceptance/opening evidence is found.
assumptions.recheck_trigger: Any later official construction, acceptance, opening, suspension or planning-decision publication.

assumptions.statement: Without segment-level field observation, timed access tests, accessibility checks and responsible-party confirmation, every current Journey outcome remains UNKNOWN.
assumptions.impact: No profile, route, interface or key area may be marked PASS or FAIL during P3.2.
assumptions.recheck_trigger: Auditable field evidence and professional review for all ordered segments and fallback routes.

assumptions.statement: The worst-served target group is proposed as the acceptance guard: one verified FAIL prevents Journey PASS; one UNKNOWN prevents Journey PASS.
assumptions.impact: This is a future acceptance rule, not an observed baseline, organizer standard or current metric.
assumptions.recheck_trigger: Professional and stakeholder review of the future Journey acceptance protocol.

assumptions.statement: At Dazhongsi, built, approved and planned objects belong to different project and operating chains, while evidence of one jointly delivered four-quadrant Journey has not been located.
assumptions.impact: The proposal may investigate a cross-project delivery/evidence gap, but may not claim that current accessibility or pedestrian conditions are physically broken.
assumptions.recheck_trigger: A joint station-road-park-parcel-property acceptance record, complete operational route agreement or contrary field/professional evidence.

assumptions.statement: After the confirmed internal Qinghe Station crossing, the station edge-to-municipal-to-park/waterfront-to-renewal-to-campus/property-to-entrance chain is a candidate cross-project interface sequence.
assumptions.impact: It can organize evidence collection but cannot be described as a confirmed physical failure.
assumptions.recheck_trigger: As-built completion evidence for the scene project plus field and responsibility-chain verification to Zhongzhiyuan destinations.

assumptions.statement: No new major intervention is required at the AI Origin study Journey unless new evidence identifies a residual problem outside or after the approved seven-node project.
assumptions.impact: P3.3 should preserve approved public-space works, verify interfaces and limit any response to evidence-based patches or no action.
assumptions.recheck_trigger: New as-built, field, accessibility, night, weather or operational evidence showing a residual gap.

assumptions.statement: Where no public document assigns end-to-end Journey responsibility, the responsible_role and maintenance_owner fields remain UNKNOWN or suggested roles, not named commitments.
assumptions.impact: No agency, company, property manager or institution may be presented as having accepted a proposed duty.
assumptions.recheck_trigger: Written responsibility, maintenance, access-hours, service-level or joint-acceptance agreement from competent parties.

assumptions.statement: The Cross-Project Journey Auditor is a checking aid for evidence ordering and re-audit; it is not a governance platform, regulatory decision-maker, social scoring system or substitute for urban design.
assumptions.impact: Its visual attention is capped at 10-15 percent and it cannot auto-generate PASS/FAIL without verified evidence.
assumptions.recheck_trigger: Any proposed feature that changes the tool into a public decision or surveillance system.

assumptions.statement: The P3.2 rule-to-design table is a preliminary risk framework, not a legal opinion or discipline-specific compliance determination.
assumptions.impact: Future spatial actions require the appropriate planning, traffic, rail, accessibility, heritage, fire, water, data-security and legal reviewers.
assumptions.recheck_trigger: Named professional reviewers and project-specific applicable-law/standard determinations.

assumptions.statement: OSM or similar reproducible public data, if used later, is background context only.
assumptions.impact: It cannot prove redlines, ownership, legal access, accessibility, facility absence or project status.
assumptions.recheck_trigger: Any attempt to use crowd-sourced map data for a formal control or absence claim.

assumptions.statement: P3.4 participant-authored geometry expresses concept-design routes, envelopes, nodes, sections and phase gates inside provisional constraints.
assumptions.impact: Lengths, areas, ratios and counts derived from these objects are CONCEPTUAL_DERIVED or DERIVED design-model values, not survey, as-built, statutory or approved quantities.
assumptions.recheck_trigger: Official boundaries, survey, regulatory controls, as-built/project drawings or a professional design revision.

assumptions.statement: Dimension values in the design catalogue are comparison targets selected from stated standards or conservative concept reservations; their project-specific applicability is unconfirmed.
assumptions.impact: They may organize spatial testing but cannot be represented as existing widths, approved engineering dimensions or universally applicable code minima.
assumptions.recheck_trigger: Current survey plus road-class, traffic, rail, architecture, fire, accessibility, drainage and maintenance review as relevant.

assumptions.statement: No complete, cleared and verified existing-building footprint dataset was available for the formal package.
assumptions.impact: Concept building envelopes cannot support existing floor area, demolition, ownership, height, FAR or density claims.
assumptions.recheck_trigger: Receipt of current official survey, cadastral/control-plan and building records.

assumptions.statement: The green-space layer contains concept recovery envelopes rather than a verified complete existing-green inventory.
assumptions.impact: No existing green ratio, improvement ratio, cooling or runoff-reduction claim may be made.
assumptions.recheck_trigger: Verified land-cover/park/tree survey and hydrology or thermal analysis.

assumptions.statement: Ownership, public access rights, opening hours and receiving maintenance roles are incomplete for the public-space and conditional ground-floor envelopes.
assumptions.impact: Concept public-space area cannot be represented as existing public space, and conditional C cannot be counted as a required Journey segment.
assumptions.recheck_trigger: Official boundary/ownership records and binding access-hours and maintenance agreements.

assumptions.statement: Dazhongsi crossing location, signals, kerbs, levels, clear widths, mode conflicts and operational performance have not been surveyed or professionally reviewed.
assumptions.impact: The proposal can reserve and compare a ground route but cannot claim an existing crossing failure or fix a permanent engineering alignment.
assumptions.recheck_trigger: Survey, six-profile timed field walk, traffic/signal analysis and rail/accessibility review.

assumptions.statement: As-built coordinates, completion status, acceptance and receiving boundaries for the Qinghe station-scene project endpoint have not been obtained.
assumptions.impact: The six handovers organize future verification but do not prove six physical failures or a fixed route.
assumptions.recheck_trigger: Current completion/as-built and handover documents plus field verification to Zhongzhiyuan destinations.

assumptions.statement: No joint rail, utility, structure, fire/egress, accessibility, ownership, public-rights or operations review supports a fixed Dazhongsi vertical or underground connection.
assumptions.impact: Option B remains HOLD_NOT_SCHEDULED and cannot weaken or replace the independent public ground baseline A.
assumptions.recheck_trigger: All named professional and public-access gates pass with approved project geometry and a maintenance agreement.

assumptions.statement: AI Origin retains approved/existing works and permits a minimal removable patch only after a post-delivery residual Journey failure is verified.
assumptions.impact: The current design has zero major intervention by choice; UNKNOWN residual failure cannot be recoded as zero problems or a FIELD_PASS.
assumptions.recheck_trigger: Approved-project delivery evidence and six-profile post-completion Journey audit.
